reviews.text: Great service!

i took buttercup my cat in for her shots and wellness check and they were lovely and actually have a house in front for all the feral, homeless kitties around there plus they neuter and spay them which is wonderful since they are putting them down by the thousands at animal control places.  they make it affordable for people to get this done so there arent so many stray animals.

Very lovely and kind all of you. Thanks for the excellent veterinary care and  of my beloved chihuahua baby.
Thanks for your outstanding support to get the right paperwork for the applications for ESA letter.

Used to be great. Now you don't even answer the phone, doctor is never in. This is embarrassing on your behalf. With an office in the shape of yours, I would try to retain all the patients i can. Get your shit together guys!!!!
Excellent clinic, very kind staff.
Excellent staff, incredibly empathetic. I love you all so much, thank you always for everything.
Amazing, caring, and knowledgeable staff. I cannot say enough wonderful things about this team. 💙
They were so kind, were able to help me and my new found cat and they helped me get an even better price on my visit :) 10/10 experience

These folks have been the most helpful vets we've experienced in Houston. They are also a low cost vet which makes caring for your critters affordable. We bring all our rescues here, felines and canines have all received the best care.
Preventions, surgeries, medications, and such are all performed here. They follow-up and try to answer any and all questions.
Also, and quite importantly, they truly care for all animals. They are what all veterinarians should be.

This place is terrible. They advertise as saving money, but it’s a huge waste of time. I walked in to get shots, they told me to come back. I came back and the Dr was out. Already annoyed because I had to take work off. They told me they could schedule me for a Saturday, then called the day before asking to reschedule. I show up the rescheduled date (again took off work for the) and they say that they texted me to cancel. I never got their text. A call would have been nice? No compassion from the front office staff, not even an I’m sorry. I understand that their vet is sick, but why even keep the practice open in this time if you don’t have a vet? I will not be back and if you value your time don’t even think about this place.

Amazing veterinary clinic! The team is friendly, professional, and genuinely cares about pets. They checked our cat thoroughly, explained everything clearly, and gave great care advice. Everyone, from the doctor to the nurse and administrative staff, is organized and professional. Highly recommend! 😺
The staff is so kind. The doctor is so knowledgeable and truly cares.

so I recently was recommended by a friend I used to take my cat to another vet which was pricier & added many fees just consultation for a neutering they were charging me $500. So I contacted Palm to Paws and they were very sweeet & attentive. I paid less than $200 for neutering, flea medication, deworming, pain medication. They did a great job explaining everything to me & following up post op surgery. Definitely recommend!
They have a friendly staff and were very caring for my sick pet.

Nice people that knows how to treat our pets with care and with love but more importantly with respect to the animals.
I love the staff and the Doctor Dev is amazing!
Very kind and caring staff.
Excellent staff they really care.

This vet is amazing! So caring of the animals and so helpful with my baby kittens. His staff is super sweet and you can tell they all really care about helping you help your animals.  I will definitely use them again. So thankful for All their help!  I also really like the fact that I could show up on Saturday and put my name in and still be seen without an appointment. Pricing was extremely affordable compared to all the other vets I called.  Even though I had to drive across town, I would do it again in a heart beat 😁

Dr. Rajan,
I am writing to express my deepest gratitude for the exceptional care you provided to my dog.
Thanks to you, my dog is now back to his happy, healthy self. I can't thank you enough for your outstanding service. You have a gift for what you do, and I will be forever grateful. You have an awesome staff.
Sonia and Russell

I have had nothing but good experiences with Palm to Paws since moving to Houston. Dr. Sarah is very sweet and kind. This summer after having a horrible experience with another clinic in The Heights they filled my cat’s travel certificate without any issues.
Excellent service for us, plus they understand us very well in Spanish, very kind translation
Friendly, attentive, knowledgable. Quality service and good prices.
I found two kitten downtown on street that had just been hit by a car and one was injured. Dr Sarah and her assistant were so helpful! Will return for spay and neuter.

Drive across town to get my poor kitty, Tater,  looked out because he isn't feeling well and I'm turned away because, "we're closing soon." They closed in 45 min, I arrived at 1:15p and they close at 2, but it's Saturday so I guess the staff had better things to do. At this posting time they're still open but I'm sorting at a light trying to make it across town to a DIFFERENT clinic so my baby doesn't have to suffer. They don't prioritize pets obviously. And no I couldn't come earlier because I had to wait for the funeral home to come pick up my mother's body because she died a few hours ago. Then I arrived at my own home to find an ill kitty. And as of RIGHT NOW they're STILL open for another 15 min and my cat is NOT being treated.
The Vet and the staff are so amazing and I just Love how they treat our fur babies and pets, knowable, professional and so sweet and kind. Highly recommend them
Make sure you make appointment.  I was walk in since they didn’t have appt and they said 45 min and it was 45 wait.  The drs. Are amazing. I would come back
Good affordable petcare. Got dental cleaning done on a 12 year old dog and they did great.
Probably the best vet around I can always be sure that they are going to tell me that absolute truth and not try to sell me on healthcare that I don’t need
Terrible service, lack of professionalism and awful customer service.

Used to be great. Been trying for weeks to get my cats in. Won't make an appointment for anything except surgery. Call when they open & say already booked for the day. Apparently you check-in with an empty office (wth?). That would be good to know. Maybe put that on the website.

I brought my kitten here as a stray kitten here a few months ago and she tested positive for a parasite. It was unclear to me that she should’ve been coming in to do a recheck once month until testing positive. Months later, she starts having the same issue and I come in to let the front desk know and she essentially does her best to not own up to the fact that the vet didn’t clearly communicate that this was something that should’ve been mandatory. Not a suggestion. I’m very upset with how things were handled in the care of my kitten.

We love Palm to Paws!! I've taken two of my pups here. The first was after several attempts to diagnose what ended up being a luxating patella. Dr. Rajan was quick to figure out what it was simply by moving his knee around. He made great recommendations for orthopedic surgeons to go to. The second dog I took here was after being turned away from neuters due to potential clotting issues common in Dobermans. Dr. Rajan tested him and was assured that he could handle a neuter. They performed his neuter around a month later and our pup is recovering beautifully.

I also have to make note of how amazing Dr. Rajan and his entire staff were with nervous/stressed dogs. My first boy was terrified and they were careful while also being cognizant of his needs. My second boy was being protective which they clocked immediately and adjusted accordingly.

Additionally, the communication from the whole staff is quick and professional. They texted me to check on my boy post-neuter and always call to remind me of any appointments.

Very happy with all of the service I get here and will continue coming!
Very caring and compassionate about my fur baby.

My  Cat lucky needed ovarian remnant surgery.I was quoted $2000.00 plus with no guarantees since it's a difficult surgery from another clinic. I was recommended Palms To Paws the vet and staff are amazing the cost was great .The surgery was a success.Thank you again.
They been taking care of all my fur babies for many years. Wonderful staff .
Great low cost clinic. My dog needed a tooth extraction and the staff was great and took such good care of my pet.
Nia was incredible with Hope, Hope is not an easy dog, but she knew how to handle her, be closer, check on her, help me to shave her to evaluate her, she was just amazing ❤️#1 Thank you!
Awesome staff nice place treat your pets with care!!!
Wonderful experience with the staff, all very kind and caring, and doctor is very knowledgeable.
There are very awesome people working here and great prices. Thankful for them.
The vet clinic is great very professional , fast service and reasonable prices.
Most caring Dr. in H-Town!

Absolutely love this clinic and trust them. I read some of the bad reviews and was a bit skeptical, but all the good reviews shined and I went ahead and took my cat to Palm to Paws. The surgery was going to cost anywhere from $3.5K to $5K at all other clinics, but Palm to Paws worked with me and my financial struggle. They even helped me when my cat accidently cut himself during the healing atage, and worked with me to get him in to have it repaired. The staff and doctor are EXTREMELY attentive and caring. They go above and beyond to answer your questions, even when I called so many times with new questions. This clinic is affordable and small, but they work hard to help their patients. Thank you again!
It's actually an excellent service, with great customer service, affordable prices, and bilingual staff.

My cat Molly, had some infected teeth and was in need of tooth extraction and teeth cleaning. The quote from the vet by my house was $1000. Palm to Paws was able to squeeze her in, get her comfortable and do the density work she needed for $710. The cleaning and teeth extraction was $600. The extra $100 was for pain meds and antibiotics before the surgery. Molly is doing great. I am so grateful for their compassion, kindness and skill. Thanks Palm to Paws staff!
I can honestly say this is the best vet ive ever been to, always takes really good care of all my dogs.
So informative and helpful! Doesn't break the bank either, everyone is so kind.
They are friendly people there
all the people who work here are very kind, and the vet is good at his job with lots of love with all his beautiful patients 😾🐈🐩🦮    Thank you!! …

Been looking for a Veterinarian since our, sadly passed away and gladly I found this clinic, the staff it's very professional and helpful, affordable prices, so thankful for everything just make sure to call to schedule a visit!

I had a wonderful experience with my strays, I was able to get 4 fixed/spayed in one day. I made my appointment about a month in advance and everything went smooth. I’m so happy to find a low cost vet clinic that will help with the stray overpopulation. Unfortunately I have a new stray, but now I know where to take her. Thank you to the staff and vets for the wonderful care :)
